data.title: 因幡巡 · 星夜窗前的真丝吊带凝望
data.description: 夜深人静的温馨卧室，月光如银倾泻在靠窗的床榻上。巡换上了轻薄的淡橙色真丝吊带睡裙，微卷的橙发松散披在光洁的肩头。她坐在被单上单手轻托下巴，透过玻璃看着窗外璀璨的星斗，微风拂动纱帘，少女眼眸中漾着温柔而隐秘的爱慕心绪。
data.location: peaceful bedroom beside large window open to night sky
data.action: sitting on rumpled bed near window in soft moonlight, sheer silk camisole slipping slightly, orange hair loose, delicate collarbone, gazing at viewer
data.lighting: ethereal silver moonlight illuminating sheer silk and bare shoulders
data.mood: poetic nocturnal intimacy, sweet shy yearning
data.promptProse: Sitting on a soft bed beside an open window under the starlit sky, Inaba Meguru wears a delicate silk camisole. Her orange hair flutters in the night breeze as she looks forward with tender, affectionate eyes.
data.animaCaption: Meguru sitting on her bed beside an open window in a silk camisole under moonlight.
